issues.explanation: Blank whitespace passes `required` validation then is trimmed to empty, creating an entity with an empty name despite the required field and the test expecting rejection.
Custom `current_entity` middleware is applied to a Livewire full-page route without registering it via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it silently stops applying on Livewire update requests.
Same Entities tenancy bullet was added under both [Unreleased] and the historic [0.0.0] release instead of only under [Unreleased].
AppServiceProvider claims the middleware is the only reader of the session key, but EntityController::switcher also reads session('current_entity_id') for currentId.

conventions.evidence: Livewire uses #[Validate]+$this->validate() and $this->authorize in app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:30 and mount authorize in Dashboard.php:17; $fillable deliberate; migrations have down(); audit via Log::channel('audit'); missing Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity and trim-after-validate pattern

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (EnsureCurrentEntity::handle, CreateEntity::uniqueSlug/Base-suffix loop), PHPDoc on models/policies, consistent style, no dead code; only stale 'only reader' comment

requirements.evidence: Entities table with entities_slug_unique and softDeletes, memberships with owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner, EntityPolicy/EntityMembershipPolicy match task, home/middleware/pick/onboarding/dashboard/switcher/navbar/routes/lang all present; edge miss: CreateEntity.php `$name = trim($this->validate()['name'])` lets '   ' pass required

scope.evidence: Diff only adds entities/tenancy, updates docs/database-schema.md, architecture, business-rules, CHANGELOG, lang, switcher/navbar; deletes obsolete home.blade.php; no members/settings/invitation/billing/locale-middleware changes

security.evidence: Gate::authorize view in EntityController::pick:78, authorize create/view in Livewire, #[Locked] Entity in Dashboard.php:14, {{ $entity->name }} escaping, Fillable allowlists; gap limited to blank-name validation bypass creating empty-named entity

simplicity.evidence: Lean DB::transaction+retry loop with MAX_SLUG_ATTEMPTS, scoped CurrentEntity context, reuse of policies/factories/Blade components, no service layers or duplication

review.summary: Change implements the full entities data model, policies, tenant session, onboarding, switcher, pick, dashboard and docs with thorough tests. Needs changes before merging mainly because blank whitespace bypasses required validation and creates an empty-named entity; otherwise only minor persistent-middleware and changelog nits.
